findings.problem: The hint 'with sich, not sitzen' still allows sich hinsetzen, which is just as common for 'to sit down' (Setz dich hin!).
findings.fix: hint: with sich, not sitzen or hinsetzen

findings.problem: In this meaning the verb is reflexive, so its dictionary form is sich setzen; a bare setzen teaches the learner that setzen alone means to sit down.

back.target: to set, to put; (sich setzen) to sit down
back.example: Do come and sit with us!

note: If the target becomes sich setzen, the hint no longer has to say 'with sich' and can just rule out sitzen and hinsetzen; the conjugation and Perfekt (hat sich gesetzt) are right.
